class.name: Subtitle
class.brief_description: A timed list of texts: subtitles and closed captions.

method.name: add_segment
method.description: Inserts [param segment] after the last segment that starts at the same time or earlier, so the list stays sorted by start time.

method.name: clear_segments
method.description: Removes all segments.

method.name: find_segment_at
method.description: Returns the first segment shown at the playback time [param time] ([member time_offset] included), or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_end_time
method.description: Returns the latest [member SubtitleSegment.end_time] plus [member time_offset], or [code]0.0[/code] without segments.

method.name: get_segment
method.description: Returns the segment at [param index].

method.name: get_segment_count
method.description: Returns the number of segments.

method.name: get_segments_at
method.description: Returns all segments shown at the playback time [param time] ([member time_offset] included), in list order. Overlapping segments are all returned.

method.name: get_start_time
method.description: Returns the earliest [member SubtitleSegment.start_time] plus [member time_offset], or [code]0.0[/code] without segments.

method.name: get_translatable_strings
method.description: Returns the entries for POT generation: one per segment with text, [code][text, context, "", comment][/code] with [member SubtitleSegment.translation_context] as the context and [code]"Speaker: name"[/code] as the translator comment when [member SubtitleSegment.speaker] is set; then one entry per distinct speaker of the dialog lines, [code][name, "speaker", "", "Speaker name"][/code]. The context [code]"speaker"[/code] is what [method SubtitleServer.get_display_speaker] and [SubtitleLabel] translate speaker names with. The editor uses it for subtitle files ([code].srt[/code], [code].vtt[/code], ...) and [Subtitle] resources added to the POT generation list ([b]Project Settings > Localization > POT Generation[/b]). The entries do not depend on [member auto_translate].

method.name: load_from_file
method.description: Replaces the segments with those of the subtitle file at [param path] and resets [member time_offset] to [code]0.0[/code]. The extension picks the format (see [enum Format]); an unknown extension returns [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED]. Unlike [method ResourceLoader.load], this fills an existing resource and skips the resource cache.

method.name: load_from_text
method.description: Replaces the segments with those read from [param text] and resets [member time_offset] to [code]0.0[/code]. Cues that can't be read are skipped. Returns [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] if [param text] has content but not a single cue could be read; the subtitle is then unchanged.

method.name: merge_segments
method.description: Merges [param count] consecutive segments, starting at [param index], into the segment at [param index]: it spans from the earliest start to the latest end, and its text is the texts of all merged segments, one per line. Speaker, kind and the other properties of the first segment are kept; the other segments are removed. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param count] is less than 2 or the range is outside the list. [codeblocks] [gdscript] subtitle.merge_segments(0) # The first two segments become one. [/gdscript] [csharp] subtitle.MergeSegments(0); // The first two segments become one. [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: remove_segment
method.description: Removes the segment at [param index].

method.name: save_to_file
method.description: Writes the subtitle to [param path] in the format of its extension (see [enum Format]), like [method to_text]. An unknown extension returns [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED].

method.name: shift_times
method.description: Adds [param seconds] to the start and end time of every segment. Unlike [member time_offset], this changes the segments themselves. See also [method sync_times].

method.name: sort_segments
method.description: Sorts the segments by start time, then by end time. Segments with the same times keep their order.

method.name: split_segment
method.description: Splits the segment at [param index] at [param time], which must lie between its start and end time. The segment ends at [param time]; a copy of it (same speaker, kind, placement and translation context) starts there and is inserted after it. The text is divided at the line break nearest to where [param time] falls within the segment, else at the nearest space; a text without either stays in the first segment. Returns the index of the new segment, or [code]-1[/code] if the segment or the time is invalid.

method.name: sync_times
method.description: Two-point sync: moves and stretches all segment times so that [param first_time] becomes [param first_target] and [param second_time] becomes [param second_target], with every other time mapped linearly between them. Use it for a subtitle that drifts against its audio or video, for example one made for a different frame rate: pick an early and a late segment and the times at which they should start. [param second_time] must differ from [param first_time], and the targets must keep the order of the times. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # The first line should start at 2.0 s, the line that now starts at 60.0 s at 62.5 s. subtitle.sync_times(1.5, 2.0, 60.0, 62.5) [/gdscript] [csharp] // The first line should start at 2.0 s, the line that now starts at 60.0 s at 62.5 s. subtitle.SyncTimes(1.5, 2.0, 60.0, 62.5); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: to_text
method.description: Returns the subtitle as text in [param format]. Every format adds [member time_offset] to the written times and writes the cues sorted by start time. For SubRip, the cues are sorted by start time and numbered from 1, and segments without text are left out, because an empty cue cannot be read back; [member time_offset] is added to the written times, because SubRip has no offset field; decorations are written back ([code][Applause][/code], music notes, [code]JOHN: [/code] in capitals, [code]<i>[/code] for [member SubtitleSegment.off_screen]); lines end with [code]\n[/code].

method.name: validate
method.description: Checks the segments for invalid times, empty texts, overlaps and text that is too long to read in time. A reading speed above [param max_characters_per_second] counts as too fast; [code]0.0[/code] skips this check. The Inspector shows the result.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], [SubtitleServer] passes each [member SubtitleSegment.text] through [method TranslationServer.translate], with [member SubtitleSegment.translation_context] as the context. The texts are then translation keys or source texts.
The locale of the texts, such as [code]"de"[/code] or [code]"en_US"[/code]. Informational.
The segments. Keep them sorted by start time ([method sort_segments]); [method validate] and the Inspector expect it.

Added to every segment time when the subtitle is played or queried. Video editors often start their timeline at [code]01:00:00[/code]; a SubRip file exported from them needs [code]-3600.0[/code]. The Inspector suggests the value.

constants.constant: WebVTT ([code].vtt[/code]): the web format (HTML5 video, YouTube, Vimeo). Speakers as [code]<v Name>[/code], top placement as the cue setting [code]line:0[/code].

TTML / DFXP ([code].ttml[/code], [code].dfxp[/code]): the XML format of broadcasters and streaming services. Reads clock times, frames ([code]ttp:frameRate[/code]), offsets ([code]1.5s[/code], [code]1500ms[/code], [code]90f[/code], ticks) and [code]dur[/code]; [code]xml:lang[/code] becomes [member language]. Off-screen as [code]tts:fontStyle="italic"[/code].

Advanced SubStation Alpha ([code].ass[/code]; [code].ssa[/code] is read too, and written in the [code].ass[/code] dialect): the format of subtitle editors such as Aegisub. Speakers in the [code]Name[/code] field, [code]{\i1}[/code] for italics, [code]{\an8}[/code] for the top; styles and other override tags are dropped.
YouTube SBV ([code].sbv[/code]): times and text only.
Represents the size of the [enum Format] enum.
